name: glitchr/omniguard
description: Omniguard: one contract for guarding a form - is this token valid (a captcha: ALTCHA, Turnstile, reCAPTCHA), is this content spam (Akismet), are this address, this e-mail, this name known for abuse (StopForumSpam, disposable e-mail domains) - whoever answers; and its Symfony bridge: a form field, a constraint, the ALTCHA challenge's route, a Twig function.

suggest.omniguard/altcha: ALTCHA: a proof of work served and checked by the site itself - no third party, no cookie, no consent; the default
suggest.omniguard/turnstile: Cloudflare Turnstile: a token checked by Cloudflare's siteverify
suggest.omniguard/recaptcha: Google reCAPTCHA: v2 checkbox and invisible, v3 score, Enterprise assessments
suggest.omniguard/akismet: Akismet: is this content spam - comment-check, submit-spam, submit-ham
suggest.omniguard/stopforumspam: StopForumSpam: are this IP address, this e-mail, this name reported for abuse
suggest.omniguard/disposable: Disposable e-mail domains: a free list shipped in the package, no call
suggest.psr/cache: A spent token remembered in a PSR-6 pool (Omniguard\Replay\CacheReplayStore) rather than in this process's memory
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omniguard\Bridge\Symfony\OmniguardBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omniguard\Bridge\Symfony\OmniguardBundle
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: In a Symfony application: Omniguard\Bridge\Symfony\OmniguardBundle itself
suggest.symfony/validator: In a Symfony application: the PassesChallenge constraint
suggest.symfony/routing: In a Symfony application: the route that serves an ALTCHA challenge
suggest.symfony/translation: In a Symfony application: the widgets' texts in the visitor's language (domain omniguard)
suggest.twig/twig: With Twig: Omniguard\Bridge\Twig\OmniguardExtension, the widget printed by omniguard_widget()
